sharedRules.name: Psyker
sharedRules.description:
**Psyker** units with this ability have a **psyker level** of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each **psychic level** of 1 or higher in its specified ability's name. 
In a battle round, a friendly **Psyker** unit can only use a number of **psychic abilities** whose total **psychic level** does not exceed that **PSYKER** unit's **psychic level**

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your command phase if this model is not **battle-shocked** you can make a **psychic roll* on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else select 1 location withing 18" of this model but 3" from all enemy units then roll 1D6+1D3:
  - 2: This model suffers D3 **Psychic Mortal Wounds**
  - 3: Summon a unit of 3 **Nurgling Swarms**
  - 4: Summon a unit of 5 **fleshhounds**
  - 5: Summon a unit of 10 **Pink Horrors**
  - 6: Summon a unit of 10 **Deamonetts**
  - 7: Summon a unit of 10 **Plaugebearers**
  - 8: Summon a unit of 10 **Bloodletters**
  - 9: Summon a unit of 3 **Flamers of Tzeench**
  The all **summoned** models must be 3" away from all enemy units. In addition they suffer 1 mortal wound at the start of each turn starting at the start of your next turn.

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your command phase if this model is not **battle-shocked** you can select 1 **enemy** unit with the **Daemonic** and/or **corrupt** keywords. You can reduce the **selected** units **toughness** and **strength** on its **melee** weapons by 1 or take a **psychic roll** on 1D6.
:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: The **selected** unit is **battle-shocked** and has -1 to its **toughness** and **strength** on its **melee** weapons

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your **shooting** phase this model can use this ability instead of shooting if this unit is not **battle-shocked**.
You can select 1 unit withing 9" of this model and improve it **toughness** by 1 or this model can make a **psychic** roll on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: The **selected** unit gains +1 **toughness** and **melee strength**
This lasts till the start of your next **shooting** phase

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your **shooting** phase this model can use this ability instead of shooting if this unit is not **battle-shocked**.
You can select 1 unit withing 9" of this model and give it **[Precision]** on **Critical Hits** or this model can make a **psychic** roll on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: The **selected** unit gains **[Precision]** on **Critical Hits** and **Critical Hits** on 5+
This lasts till the end of the phase it was used

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your **Movement** phase this model can use this ability instead of moving if this unit is not **battle-shocked**.
This models unit gains a **Invulnerable Save 6+** if it doesn't already have one or this model can make a **psychic roll** on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: This unit gains a **Invulnerable Save 6+** or if it already has one **improve** it by 1 to a **minimum** of a 4+

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
Once per turn at the start of any phase as long as this model is not **battle-shocked** you can select 1 **enemy** unit withing 24" and **line of sight** of this model. Then make a **psychic roll** on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: The **selected** unit can not be targeted by **enemy stratigems** for the rest of the turn

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your **shooting** phase this model can use this ability instead of shooting if this unit is not **battle-shocked**.
You can target 1 **enemy** unit withing 36" and withing **line of sight** of this model then roll 6D6. Then count up each 4+. The **targeted** unit then must take a **leadership test** minus the number of 4+ you made. If the **targeted** unit fails it becomes **pinned**.

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your **shooting** phase this model can use this ability instead of shooting if this unit is not **battle-shocked**.
You can select 1 unit withing 9" of this model and make a **psychic roll** on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: Roll 1D6 for each missing model and on each 5+ **heal(1)**

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
If this model is not **battle-shocked**you can use this instead of shooting. This model can mae a **psychic roll** on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: Select 1 unit withing 6". That unit gets **heal(1)**

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your **movement** phase this model can use this ability if this model has moved withing 12" of an **enemy unit** and this unit is not **battle-shocked**.
You can make a **psychic** roll on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: This unit gains a **Invulnerable Save 6+** or if the unit already has one improve it by 1 to a **minimum** of 3+

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your **Charge** phase this model can use this ability if this model declares a **charge** and this unit is not **battle-shocked**.
You can make a **psychic** roll on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: This models unit gains **Hammer of Wrath 2**

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your **Movement** phase this model can use this ability if this model has not **moved** and this unit is not **battle-shocked**.
You can make a **psychic** roll on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: This models unit gains +3" to their **movement**

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your **Shooting** phase this model can use this ability if this model has not **Shoot** and this unit is not **battle-shocked**.
You can make a **psychic** roll on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: The first attack from each model in this models unit gains **[Precision]**

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your **Shooting** phase this model can use this ability if this model has **shot** and this unit is not **battle-shocked**.
You can make a **psychic** roll on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: Select 1 unit that was hit by this model's unit **ranged** weapons. That unit has -1 **leadership rolls** till the start of your next turn

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your command phase if this model is not **battle-shocked** you can make a **psychic roll** on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: Add 1 to this units movement, melee to hit and melee attacks

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your **shooting** phase this model can use this ability instead of shooting if this unit is not **battle-shocked**.
You can select up to 2 unit withing 12" then make a **psychic** roll on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: Both units have +1BS

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
In your command phase if this model is not **battle-shocked** you can make a **psychic roll** on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **battle-shocked**
- Else: This units ranged weapons have **[Lethal Hits 4+]** and **[Ignores Cover]**

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
At the start of the Fight phase, if this unit is not **battle-shocked**, you can make a **psychic roll** for this unit by rolling 2D6 but minus the number of times this has been used in a row this battle. If you do:
- On a 6-, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds
- On a 7+, this model gains **[Feel No Pain 4+]** and +1 melee attacks till the end of the phase

profiles.name: Shadows of Past and Future (Psychic level 1)

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:
At the start of the fight phase if this unit is not **battle-shocked** you can make a **psychic roll** by rolling 1D6, if you do:
- On a 1: **Sevatar** suffers D3 mortal wounds
- Else: **Sevatar** gains +1 to hit and +1 attacks to **Night's Whisper**  for the rest of the phase.

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text: All **Friendly Thousand Sons infantry** models that have **Psychicly Gifted (Psyker Level 1)** count as being **Psyker Level 2** whiel withing 12"

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text: If your army includes this model, after both players have deployed their armies, you can select up to 3 ^^**Thousand Sons^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

characteristics.name: Descriptions

- On a 1: This unit is suffer D3 **Psychic Mortal Wounds**
- Else: Restore D3 **Bodygaurd** model

characteristics.name: Descriptions

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text:

- On a 1: This model is **battle-shocked**
- Else: The target is **pinned**

characteristics.name: Descriptions
characteristics.$text: While this model is leading a unit, that unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

characteristics.name: Descriptions

Once per phase after rolling a group of dice for this model's unit whilt its not **battle-shocked** you can make a **psychic roll** on 1D6:
- On a 1: This unit is **Battle-shocked**
- Else: You can set 1 of the values to be 6

characteristics.name: Descriptions

characteristics.name: Descriptions

characteristics.name: Descriptions

- On a 1:This unit is **battle-shocked**
